finding.required_repair: Retain the first checked_fixture returned identity/bytes/SHA and use it with known fixed path/fresh mode/kind in the existing original checkpoint_bytes reader; copy only the accepted raw bytes with original copy_blob. Check all five actual destination bytes against the accepted fixed values. Do not resample a new acceptance row or reopen plain path after fixed validation.
finding.root_cause: Four fixtures use a newly sampled file_record after fixed-byte checked_fixture acceptance, so a replacement regular inode is accepted with a new SHA instead of the first fixed identity/size/SHA. The fifth keycert uses plain Path.read_bytes after acceptance, which can follow a replacement symlink. The immutable first-reader result is discarded in both paths.
finding.title: Certificate copier discards the first fixed-reader binding and copies post-validation replacement bytes
